answer.value: Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg has the highest average fire incidents (28.78), followed by Mitte and Tempelhof-Schöneberg. The lowest fire incidents are in Treptow-Köpenick (7.58) and Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf (9.12). Central districts generally have higher fire incidents than peripheral districts, likely due to higher population density and urban activity

key_insights: Central districts have higher fire incidents than peripheral districts
Significant variation between highest and lowest districts
Fire incidents appear to correlate with urban density
